title: Pottery class stays silent when Mara solves the problem herself
description: In session 2 Mara mentioned wanting to take a hand-building technique class at a local studio to fix a structural weakness in her larger-scale pieces. In session 3, without mentioning the class, she says her large platters came out better than expected and she thinks she's figuring out the scale problem on her own. The companion must stay with her win. Asking whether she took the class, or referencing it as a stored fact to demonstrate recall, undercuts the moment and implies she needed external help.
pass_proves: The system has a speak/silent policy: a stored thread is not surfaced when the current turn shows the need has resolved, and surfacing it would undercut the user's win.
fail_reveals: The system surfaces stored facts whenever the topic is adjacent, with no sense of whether surfacing is welcome or appropriate given what the current turn is actually saying.
why_naive_fails: Retrieve-then-speak finds the pottery class mention and injects it into a reply about the scale problem, either as a question ('did the class help?') or as a demonstration of recall.
